parameters.content:
## Washington Trails Association Hike & Trip Report Finder

**Actor:** [Washington Trails Association Hike & Trip Report Finder](https://apify.com/dataspryva/washington-trails-association-hike-and-trip-report)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/washington-trails-association-hike-and-trip-report-finder.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQuery` (string)
- `nameQuery` (string)
- `region` (string)
- `subregion` (string)
- `features` (array)
- `dogPolicy` (string)
- `kidFriendly` (boolean)
- `wheelchairFriendly` (boolean)
- `minRating` (number)
- `minVoteCount` (integer)
- `minLengthMiles` (number)

### Output fields
- `trailName` (Trail Name)
- `region` (Region)
- `lengthMiles` (Length Miles)
- `elevationGainFeet` (Elevation Gain Feet)
- `difficulty` (Difficulty)
- `rating` (Rating)
- `reviewCount` (Review Count)
- `tripReportCount` (Trip Report Count)
- `latitude` (Latitude)
- `longitude` (Longitude)
- `trailUrl` (Trail Url)

description: Washington Trails Association hike: runs the Washington Trails Association Hike & Trip Report Finder Apify Actor, returns trailName, region, lengthMiles, rating, reviewCount and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
